name: matlab-optimize-portfolio
description: Formulate and solve portfolio optimization problems in MATLAB. Routes to the Financial Toolbox Portfolio object for mean-variance (Markowitz), minimum- variance, target-return, maximum Sharpe ratio, and efficient frontier problems with bounds, budget, group, turnover, tracking-error, or cardinality constraints; or to the problem-based framework (optimproblem/optimvar/solve) when constraints exceed what Portfolio can express: integer round lots, whole shares, per-lot or fixed commissions, minimum trade sizes, semi-integer positions, wash-sale rules, realized capital-gains caps, tax-loss harvesting, asymmetric or bucketed transaction- cost caps, or a custom efficient frontier over such constraints. Use when users ask about portfolio optimization, when they attempt quadprog, fmincon, intlinprog, or ga for a portfolio problem, or when code rounds Portfolio weights to whole shares or lots.
